main_learning: Setting up templates, quality gates, a content plan and a safety check before research starts makes it easier to stay consistent and keep public/private boundaries clear.
Re-validating bounty programs directly against the live Immunefi page, and re-checking the full in-scope asset list carefully, avoids missing newer scope additions.

When a target has multiple third-party audits covering different subsystems at different times, check whether your cloned commit is before or after each report's fixed-version commit, rather than assuming the latest clone is fully post-fix everywhere.

'Temporary freezing of funds' can sit at Medium or High depending on a program's specific severity table, not just the generic Immunefi category name; worth checking that table explicitly when framing severity.
